DoomParticipant.title: Doom Participant
DoomParticipant.description: A team member on the Dooms Month leaderboard with their current Doom Points score.

note.description: Optional short note describing the latest point change.

createdBy.description: UID of the organizer who created the entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest point or profile update.

AdminUser.title: Admin User
AdminUser.description: Authorized organizer UID permitted to manage Doom Points.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/doomParticipants/{participantId}.description: Publicly readable Dooms Month leaderboard entries; writable only by verified organizers.
